pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take:
**Rafe out here draftin' teams like he's pickin' random letter tiles from a Scrabble bag.** Man's got Germany, Ecuador, Mexico, Tunisia, Scotland, and Uzbekistan like he's tryna cover all continents in one go. It's no wonder The Noisemaker is sittin' dead last with 29 points — can't win a soccer pool when your strategy is pure chaos and your first picks don't even hit the field. He might be throwin' darts blindfolded, but hey, maybe that's just his style; don't hold your breath for a miracle on this one.

Now, Devin, aka Ghost Pepper, is heatin' things up after that 1-0 win by Spain over Portugal, rackin' up a cool 8 points — boy's just 5 points shy of catchin' Bubba G at the top. But I gotta say, Devin pickin' the USA thinkin' it's gonna be a win against Belgium is like bettin' on a tortoise in a NASCAR race — wishful at best. He better hope Spain keeps puttin' in work 'cause ain't nobody else on his roster backin' him up.

Then there's Bubba G cruisin' in first place with France leadin' his charge — my man's actin' like he knows somethin' we don't with his DR Congo pick, probably got that intel from his favorite taco truck guy. But if France keeps playin' like they got gas in the tank, Gunner might just grind out that top spot all the way through. Still, can't wait to see how this man's mystery roster holds up when it counts; he's gonna need all the luck his local bodega can offer.

Mustard Boy, aka Zach, got Brazil up in there, but hold the phone — Saudi Arabia? Looks like my boy thought oil money meant goals, but he's just tryin' to refine his way outta fourth place with 35 points. Brazil's gonna have to play like they're samba dancin' on the field if Zach wants to climb outta that hole. Gayden's the only thing standin' between him and the cellar, and The Backpass Assassin's tofu lineup ain't exactly knockin' anyone's socks off.

rome_analytics_quotes: Gunner's cruising with 63 points, but Devin's golden boy Haaland might just be his kryptonite.
Rafe's draft day blunder still haunts: zero World Cup teams in his first picks.
Devin vs. Rafe: Double zero champion odds, but Rafe dominates head-to-head 6 to -6.
Sim's feeling generous: Rafe, a soccer rookie, remains surprisingly competitive despite a 0% win chance.
